review_candidates.title: Tier 2 Field Technician
review_candidates.description: Full-Time | Houston, TX | Local Travel Required About Us We are a small, concierge Managed Service Provider (MSP) focused on providing exceptional IT support and technology services to a select group of business clients. We take pride in knowing our clients and their environments and providing the kind of personal service that is difficult to find in the IT industry. We're looking for a Tier 2 Field Support Technician who wants to be part of that kind of environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, working directly with clients, and having the opportunity to work with a variety of technologies. You won't be buried in a giant queue answering the same five questions all day. You'll have the opportunity to learn, troubleshoot, work onsite, and develop real relationships with the businesses we support. Why You'll Like This Job We're a small team, and we think that's one of the best things about working here. You won't be lost in a large IT department or buried in a call-center queue. If you see a better way to do something, we want to hear it. The Role As a Tier 2 Field Support Technician, you'll provide both remote and onsite technical support for our clients. You'll be expected to handle the majority of day-to-day technical issues independently while knowing when something needs to be escalated to another member of our team. A typical day might include troubleshooting a workstation issue in the morning, helping a client resolve a Microsoft 365 problem, replacing a network device at another client's office, troubleshooting a SonicWall VPN, and helping diagnose a FreePBX phone-system issue. Every day is a little different—and that's part of the fun. What You'll Do • Provide Tier 2 technical support remotely and onsite. • Troubleshoot Windows workstations, laptops, printers, applications, and connectivity issues. • Support Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and common business applications. • Troubleshoot networking issues including DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VLANs, VPNs, and general TCP/IP connectivity. • Work with SonicWall firewalls and security appliances. • Troubleshoot and support business networks, switches, wireless access points, and other network equipment. • Support FreePBX/Asterisk-based phone systems, including extensions, handsets, SIP, trunks, and call routing. • Perform workstation deployments, equipment replacements, office moves, and other onsite projects. • Assist with new-user setups and technology onboarding. • Work with senior members of the team on more complex infrastructure, security, networking, and cloud issues. • Properly document work performed in our ticketing/PSA system. • Communicate with clients throughout the life of an issue and make sure they know what's happening. • Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve a client's environment. • Follow security, change-management, and documentation procedures. What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who is technically capable, dependable, curious, and good with people. You don't need to know everything. Nobody on our team does. What matters to us is that you know how to troubleshoot, aren't afraid to research something you haven't seen before, and are willing to ask for help when you've reached the edge of your expertise. The right person will: • Take ownership of problems instead of simply passing them along. • Be comfortable working independently at a client's office. • Think through problems rather than blindly following a checklist. • Communicate well with both technical and non-technical people. • Be comfortable talking directly with business owners and key decision-makers. • Treat clients' businesses, systems, and information with care. • Understand that documentation is part of doing the job. • Be organized enough to manage several clients and priorities. • Be willing to learn new technologies. • Be someone our clients will feel comfortable having in their office. • Be a good teammate and someone others can rely on. Technical Qualifications Required • 3+ years of professional IT support experience. • Strong Windows troubleshooting skills. • Microsoft 365 experience. • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals. • Experience with Active Directory and/or Microsoft Entra ID. • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. • Good written and verbal communication. • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation. • Ability to travel to client locations throughout our service area. Highly Preferred • Previous MSP experience. • SonicWall experience. • Experience with firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, switches, and wireless networks. • FreePBX / Asterisk experience. • Experience troubleshooting SIP, extensions, trunks, phones, and VoIP issues. • Microsoft Intune experience. • Experience with an RMM and PSA/ticketing platform. • Experience with endpoint security/EDR. • Backup and disaster-recovery experience. • Microsoft, CompTIA, SonicWall, or other relevant certifications. A Note About Working in a Concierge MSP Working for a small MSP can be rewarding, but it isn't always predictable. You may support several clients in the same day. Priorities can change quickly. You may encounter a technology you've never worked with before. Occasionally, a seemingly simple problem turns into something much more complicated. That's okay. We expect our technicians to stay professional, communicate when priorities change, research problems when necessary, and ask for help when appropriate. Most importantly, we expect you to own the problem until it is resolved or successfully handed off. Our clients hire us because they don't want to worry about their technology. Our job is to give them that confidence. Because we're a small team, every team member makes a visible impact. We are looking for someone who is dependable, professional, curious, and comfortable taking responsibility rather than waiting to be told what to do. If you enjoy solving problems, working directly with clients, learning new technologies, and being part of a close-knit technical team, you'll likely enjoy working with us. Schedule & After-Hours Expectations Normal working hours are 8am to 5pm, Monday through Friday. Occasional after-hours work may be required for scheduled maintenance, client projects, or urgent business-critical issues. After-hours work will be handled according to our established scheduling and compensation policies. Physical & Field Requirements This is a field-support position and requires regular travel to client locations. You should be comfortable: • Traveling to client offices throughout our service area. • Working under desks and around office/network equipment. • Standing and walking for periods of time. • Installing and replacing computers, monitors, network equipment, printers, and related technology. • Lifting and carrying typical IT equipment. • Occasionally working outside normal business hours for scheduled projects or urgent issues. Compensation & Benefits Salary: $60,000–$80,000, depending on experience. Benefits may include: • [Health] • [Paid Time Off] • [Paid Holidays] • [Training and certification reimbursement] • [Other benefits] Interested? If this sounds like the kind of IT environment you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you. Please send us your resume along with a brief description of your IT experience and the technologies you've worked with. We're not necessarily looking for someone who checks every box. We're looking for someone who is smart, dependable, curious, and cares about doing good work for our clients. Taulbee Consulting Company is an equal opportunity employer.
